Thanks for the clear summary and the redline. A few clarifying items from our side:

1) Procurement timeline: We generally need an executed contract before we raise a PO, but exceptions exist for pilots. We'll confirm by EOD Monday if a PO is required up front.

2) On operator-level attestations: Security is asking for either (A) operator contract language that names the operator as a processor under the DPA/UK addendum, or (B) a curated attenuation packet that demonstrates (i) no persistent KV persistence outside the region, (ii) access controls (KMS/HSM binding), and (iii) subprocessor screening results. Option (B) is acceptable to us if the evidence is concrete.

3) Please send a subprocessor matrix with: vendor, function, locations (country), and whether they are an operator (edge/cache/infra).

Attaching TheraHealth's preferred TIA template so we can scope the technical annex faster.

Kim / Laura —

Quick technical note to support the attenuation packet. Below is a concise summary I will include in the packet and the two spreadsheets attached. Please flag anything I miss.

Operator attenuation highlights (for TheraHealth Security):
- KV cache residency: per our runtime design, session-level KV caches are ephemeral and pinned to region-specific GPU pools (UK region pools for EU/UK traffic). No long-term persistence outside selected region; we will provide timeframe and retention TTLs.
- Onshore fallback: if UK pool saturated, requests will preferentially route to EU onshore fallback (same jurisdiction). Cross-border routing only occurs in exceptional overload scenarios; those are logged and audited.
- KMS/HSM: keys for UK-resident workloads can be customer-managed (bring-your-own-key) via supported KMS integrations; HSM attestation excerpts included.
- Subprocessor list (attached): operator vendors are tagged in operator_matrix.csv with function (edge/cache/orchestration) and country of processing.
- Audit artifacts: we can provide a sample access log snippet and an extract of our per-request routing trace for a non-prod sample.

Attachments: operator_matrix.csv, subprocessor-residency-sheet.xlsx

I will prepare a 1–2 page attenuation packet combining the above plus the redline pointers. Target to send by Tue EOD (tomorrow).

Thanks,
Rishi
Principal Infra Architect — Redwood Inference
(rishi_malhotra@redwood.com)
